chair
  api (backend, hono)
    services: Service
      GET /services
      GET /services/[id]
      POST /services
      PATCH /services/[id]
      DELETE /services/[id]
      GET /services/[id]/slots
    slots: Slot
      GET /slots
      GET /slots/[id]
      POST /slots
      DELETE /slots/[id]
      GET /slots/[id]/bookings
    clients: Client
      GET /clients
      GET /clients/[id]
      POST /clients
      PATCH /clients/[id]
      DELETE /clients/[id]
      GET /clients/[id]/bookings
    bookings: Booking
      GET /bookings
      GET /bookings/[id]
      DELETE /bookings/[id]
    open_slots (endpoint)
      GET /clients/[client]/open
      steps: find_open_slots
    book (endpoint)
      POST /book
      steps: book_slot
    bookings_of (endpoint)
      GET /clients/[client]/upcoming
      steps: find_bookings
  web (frontend, nextjs) uses api
    theme: from its look
    viewer: Client from clients, picked on /pick
    nav: top, /services, /book, /bookings, /me
    /: load services from services, Hero, list of ServiceCard(services)
    /pick: load clients from clients, ClientPicker(clients), JoinClients
    /clients/new: form clients.create, then /pick
    /me: ClientView(viewer)
    /services: load services from services, list of ServiceCard(services)
    /services/[id]: load service from services by id, ServiceView(service)
    /services/new: form services.create, then /services/[id]
    /slots/new: form slots.create, then /book
    /book: load open from open_slots as the viewer, SlotPicker(open)
    /bookings: load mine from bookings_of as the viewer, list of BookingCard(mine)
    Hero
      says: Your chair is waiting. / Book a cut, a color or a shave in a few taps.
      links to /book
    ClientPicker(clients: list of Client)
      shows: clients.name
      picks the viewer, then /book
    JoinClients
      says: New here?
      links to /clients/new
    ClientView(client: Client)
      shows: client.name, client.email, client.phone
    ServiceCard(service: Service)
      shows: service.name, service.minutes, service.price
      links to /services/[id]
    ServiceView(service: Service)
      shows: service.name, service.minutes, service.price, service.about
      links to /book
    SlotPicker(open: list of Slot)
      shows: open.starts_at, open.service
      says: Pick a time
      open.service links to /services/[id]
      calls book as the viewer (client), passing slot
    BookingCard(booking: Booking)
      shows: booking.slot, booking.booked_at, booking.note
      deletes via bookings.delete, then /bookings
  data (4 entities)
    Service
    Slot
    Client
    Booking
